title: I Changed My Mind About Ranged Weapons | RuneScape Dragonwilds
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Is It Time to Retire Dorgeshuun?
description:
Which ranged weapons are worth upgrading in RuneScape: Dragonwilds? I compare tier-eight shortbows, longbows and crossbows, test their special attacks and ammunition, and choose what I’d actually carry.

And after testing Blurite against my favourite Dorgeshuun Crossbow, is it finally time for a change?

00:00 Is It Time to Retire Dorgeshuun?
00:23 Update 1.0.1 & Testing Setup
01:03 Crystal Bow
01:55 Magic Shortbow
02:28 Undead Ranger’s Bow
03:07 Wild Scout’s Shortbow

04:21 Longbows & Hunter Stagbow
04:48 Ulv’s Longbow
05:10 Bow of Elidinis
05:34 Magic Longbow
05:53 Longbow Rankings
06:18 Crossbows & Weak-Point Testing
06:43 Rune Crossbow
06:58 Shadow Crossbow
07:45 Dragon Crossbow (Tier 9)
08:21 Dorgeshuun vs Blurite
09:30 Has Dorgeshuun Been Dethroned?
09:41 Final Ranged Loadout
09:57 24-Hour Stream & Outro

This ranged weapon guide covers:
• Shortbow rankings: Crystal Bow, Wild Scout’s Shortbow, Undead Ranger’s Bow and Magic Shortbow.
• Longbow rankings: Hunter Stagbow, Ulv’s Longbow, Bow of Elidinis and Magic Longbow.
• Crossbow comparisons: Rune, Shadow, Blurite and Dorgeshuun, plus the tier-nine Dragon Crossbow.
• Rune ammunition, bone bolts, enchanted rune bolts and enchanted adamant bolts.
• Weak-point hits, special attacks, handling, ammunition costs and practical weapon choices.

TESTING SETUP
Tested on update 1.0.1, following the 14 October 2026 update.
Main comparison: tier-eight weapons, 99 Ranged, three pieces of ranged armour and no amulet.
Rune arrows and rune bolts where compatible; bone bolts for Dorgeshuun. Enchanted ammunition is identified during the comparisons.
The Dragon Crossbow is naturally tier nine and is shown separately.

These are my findings and personal recommendations for this version of the game. Later updates may change weapon behaviour or balance. The comparisons include recorded hits and practical use; they are not a complete sustained-DPS benchmark or a ranking for every progression tier.

What’s your everyday ranged weapon—and which one do you keep for its special attack?
